title: 第13章 剑在哪第14章 准备
slug: 老乡你咋还会搓火球嘞
content_zh:
“你知道旧法四宗吗？”
老刘头用一根烧火棍拨弄着炉子中的炭火。
张绝摇头。
“关于旧法的所有学校都不教，相关的书也都是禁书。”
“不让你们知道是对的。”老刘头的神情却有些黯然，“那些东西了解的越多反而越没好处。”
“旧法四宗——上、和、气、辰，是在后金建国前，传习最强法门的四个宗派，明朝皇帝就是借助了四宗里三个宗门的支持，才成就霸业。”
“但在后金鼠妖窃法窃国祸乱神州之后，绝大部分宗门被灭门，四宗也难逃一劫，仅有半个上宗投降被并入旗列，其他三宗的传承几乎彻底丧失，只有零星传人行走在民间。”
“这些人在后金三百年的国祚中闹出了不少大乱子——和、气二宗起义，蜀川剑徒起义，东海杀鼠，赤血北行......就算到了后金末期，也就是六十多年前的拜福音教起义中，也都有四宗传人的影子。”
“后金皇室对他们的抓捕打压也是不留余力，只要有传闻说类似的人现世了，都会遭到宁错杀不放过的追杀！”
“三百多年的时间里，那些四宗传人到处逃亡，又到处造反，几乎一生都没停下来过，于是他们给自己的每一代传人取了称呼——”
“行走。”
张绝听到这不由得摇了摇头。
“不如叫什么圣子、仙传什么的好听唬人。”
老刘头呲着牙花乐起来。
“扯旗造反的时候，那些活不下去，跟着他们一起造反的农民就是这样叫他们的。”
“这些人一代传一代，前面还能多找些合适的弟子把传承续下去，可到了后来，能找到一个愿意接手还有天赋接手的人就不错了。”
“和宗的人最惨，我听说他们的法最难修，对天赋的要求最苛刻，有一代可怜的行走上半辈子在造反，造反造到五十岁才发现自己身边一个能传法的人都没有，后来他就开始找啊，从琼崖找到了北漠，从东海找到了西贝湖，最后你猜怎么着！”
此时的老刘头就像是巷口喜欢聊八卦的张大妈，全然没了平常那副木讷少言的样子。
张绝眨了眨眼。
“他没找到？”

“他找到了。”老刘头哈哈大笑起来，“但只能找到一个洋鬼子！一个原本来我们这传教的洋鬼子！”
“气宗也好不到哪去，那些喜欢刮风下雨的疯子后来干起了盗墓的行当，因为他们的传承传着传着丢了一半，只能去有线索的墓找。”
“辰宗更是落魄，那什么破烂法传到最后一代，实在是找不到人，无奈选中了路边一个逃荒的乞丐，教他还得从识字教起！”
老刘头一边笑一边拍着腿。
“一个老叫花子带着个小叫花，不好好讨饭，却每天学什么天地君亲师，什么日月星三辰耀神州，什么驱除鼠妖，再造神华！”
“可笑明明法已经变了，早在后金建国时，所有的旧法就越来越难修，到了他们这一代，别说修成什么样，光是修出点气来，都是了不得的大成就，那个老叫花子还是天天给小叫花子讲，他们辰宗以前怎样以天星为媒，参天悟地！”
“还说他们辰宗藏了不知道多少宝贝，随便找一个出来，都能轰死后金的鼠皇帝！”
“明明吃了上顿没下顿，要饭都要到和尚庙了，却还是在那和小乞丐说，他的天赋如何如何出彩，说他就是这一代的辰宗行走，还要好好修法，未来一定让天下瞩目！”
“他讲得太多，也说得太多，还真把小乞丐给骗到了，以为自己惊才绝艳，是绝世天才，后面除了讨饭就是抱着那些破口诀修法，结果就这样修了小半辈子，连个屁也没修出来，最后只能去拉黄包车糊口度日，为了一口棺材奔波半生！”
“绝哥儿！你说天底下怎么有这么蠢的人？简直蠢到没边了！”
老刘头笑得眼泪都出来，张绝却没有笑，他只是静静地看着老刘头，抬起茶壶给他的茶杯填满了一杯水。
content_en:
"Do you know the four sects of the old law?"
Old Liu Tou flicked the charcoal in the stove with a fire stick.
Zhang Jue shook his head.
"No schools teach about the old law, and related books are banned."
"It's right not to let you know." Old Liu Tou looked a little sad, "The more we know about those things, the less beneficial they will be."
"The four sects of the old method - Shang, He, Qi, and Chen - were the four sects that taught the most powerful methods before the founding of the Later Jin Dynasty. The emperor of the Ming Dynasty relied on the support of three of the four sects to achieve his hegemony."
"But after the Golden Rat Demon stole the law and the country and wreaked havoc on China, most of the sects were wiped out, and four sects could not escape the disaster. Only half of the sects surrendered and were incorporated into the banner. The inheritance of the other three sects was almost completely lost, and only sporadic descendants are walking among the people."
"These people caused a lot of chaos in the 300 years of the Later Jin Dynasty - the uprising of the He and Qi sects, the Sichuan Swordsman uprising, the killing of rats in the East China Sea, and the northward march of the Red Blood... Even at the end of the Later Jin Dynasty, that is, in the Evangelical Uprising more than 60 years ago, there were still shadows of descendants of the four sects."
"The royal family of the Hou Jin Dynasty also spared no effort in arresting and suppressing them. As long as there are rumors that similar people have appeared in the world, they will be hunted down without mercy!"
"For more than three hundred years, the descendants of the four sects fled everywhere and rebelled everywhere, almost never stopping in their lives, so they gave each generation of their descendants a name——"
"Walking."
Zhang Jue couldn't help but shook his head when he heard this.
"It's better to call it something like Holy Son or Immortal Legend or something that sounds nice to fool people."
Old Liu gritted his teeth and became happy.
"When they rebelled, the peasants who couldn't survive and rebelled with them were called that."
"These people are passed down from generation to generation. We can still find more suitable disciples to continue the inheritance, but later on, it will be good to find someone who is willing to take over and has the talent to take over."
"The people of Hezong are the worst. I heard that their Dharma is the most difficult to cultivate and the requirements for talent are the most stringent. There is a generation of poor people who have been rebelling for the past half of their lives. They rebelled until they were fifty years old only to find that there was no one around them who could teach the Dharma. Then he started looking. He found Bei Mo from Qiong Ya, and found Xibei Lake from East China Sea. In the end, guess what!"
At this time, Old Liu Tou was like Aunt Zhang who liked to gossip in the alley, without her usual dull and talkative look.
Zhang Jue blinked.
"He didn't find it?"
"He found it." Old Liu Tou burst out laughing, "But he could only find one foreign devil! A foreign devil who originally came to our country to preach!"
"The airbenders are not much better. Those lunatics who like wind and rain later started to rob tombs. Because half of their inheritance was lost from time to time, they could only go to the tombs with clues to find them."
"The Chen Sect is even more depressed. The shabby method has been passed down to the last generation, and there is really no one to find. So we have no choice but to choose a beggar who is running away on the roadside. To teach him, we have to start with literacy!"
Old Liu Tou laughed and patted his legs.
"An old beggar and a young beggar don't beg for food, but they learn every day about the king of heaven and earth, about the sun, moon and stars shining in China, about driving away rat demons and recreating the divine glory!"
"It's ridiculous that the Dharma has changed. As early as the founding of the Later Jin Dynasty, all the old Dharma became more and more difficult to practice. By their generation, let alone what kind of cultivation they have achieved, just gaining some energy in cultivation is an incredible achievement. The old beggar still tells the little beggar every day how their Chen sect used to use the stars as matchmakers to reach heaven and enlightenment!"
"They also said that Chen Zong has hidden countless treasures. If you find any of them, you can kill the golden rat emperor!"
"It was clear that he had to go to the monk's temple to beg for food, but he still told the little beggar how brilliant his talent was, saying that he was the leader of this generation's Chen Zong, and that he had to practice the law well, so that in the futureIt will surely attract the world’s attention! "
"He talked too much and talked too much. He really deceived the little beggar into thinking that he was amazingly talented and a peerless genius. Later, in addition to begging for food, he practiced the Dharma with those broken formulas. As a result, he practiced like this for half his life without even achieving anything. In the end, he could only earn a living by pulling a rickshaw, and spent half his life working for a coffin! "
"Brother Jue! How come there are such stupid people in the world? It's so stupid! "
Old Liu Tou laughed so much that he burst into tears, but Zhang Jue did not laugh. He just looked at Old Liu Tou quietly, raised the teapot and filled his teacup with a cup of water.
